svg.title: Himanshu Chandela, software engineer
svg.desc: Pixel-art title screen. Left: the name Himanshu Chandela, the role Software Engineer, and the focus areas deep learning, computer vision and data structures and algorithms, above a terminal that compiles a competitive-programming solution (accepted) and runs a training script. Right: the developer in a green hoodie and headphones typing at a desk at night, with a neural-network poster, code on the monitor, a coffee mug, a plant and a blinking PC tower.
